title: [GMCP 203.015.02] Production path: MCP Apps extension and secure interactive UI
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-015-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP hosts and consumes the stable MCP Apps extension end to end: resources and tool results can declare trusted UI metadata, render in a sandboxed surface, call permitted tools, update state, and degrade to accessible non-visual content. CSP, origin isolation, permissions, accessibility, lifecycle, version negotiation, hostile app content and cross-app data separation pass the official extension suite and browser security tests. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
